text: I am in the WAIT camp and filed reclaim:ma_20 on H1; that is the trigger I ratify. SN is a retracement by proxy (C7, adx NOT_SERVED): W hh_hl_3 HH/HL, D last_bar red, dist_to_20bar_high_pct 2.55. A strong run away from the average is climax risk (C19), so the first pullback only. The Creek pull-in then bar_high is still pullback-first and I can live with it; a bare daily bar_high break with no pull-in I would not. A pivot_high +5pct cap fits my no-extension rule and I accept it. Wrong on a daily close more than 1 ATR under the 20-day average.
